title: [CCTV Subtitled Dubbing] CLO Official Tutorial Video ~ Fine-tuning Part p04 4. Aligning the Shoulder Line
description:
【Teaching Materials Available on WeChat Official Account】The official Chinese dubbed and subtitled tutorial videos are finally here~~~!!! Don’t wait, catch up with us and start learning now!  
You are just one step away from becoming a CLO master~  
Follow our WeChat official account CLO3D, reply with “practice files” to get the official CLO Chinese tutorial videos along with the accompanying practice files.
transcript:
Open the ProduceFiles folder and find the C.AligningShoulderSims file in the FindTuning folder.  
In the T-ShirtAligningShoulderSims file, drag it to the 3D or 2D window.  
Press 5 on the keyboard to switch to the top view.  
In the 3D toolbar, select the surface length measurement virtual model tool from the virtual model tools.  
Start creating a virtual tape, with the orange dots moving along the mouse cursor.  
Press once along the shoulder line at the height of the shoulder, then point the mouse cursor to the endpoint.  
Double-click to complete the virtual tape creation.  
In the 3D toolbar, left-click on the virtual model tape tool.  
Select the 3D model measurement tool.  
Click on the 3D clothing line.  
The bar becomes transparent.  
Then click on the virtual measurement created earlier.  
Both lines will be shown in red.  
The 3D clothing line will move and align to the virtual model measurement line.  
In the 3D toolbar, select the move tool.  
If the T-shirt line is far from the actual line, the clothing will shake sharply and may cause the wear effect to be undesirable.  
In the simulated state, gently pull the clothing until it fits the virtual model.  
In the 3D toolbar, select the improve clothing quality tool.  
In the 3D toolbar, click OK.  
Activate the simulation.  
In the 3D toolbar, select the edit measurement virtual model tool.  
Rotate the virtual model as needed to clearly see the virtual measurement on the shoulder.  
Click on the virtual measurement line, then press the delete key on the keyboard.  
Activate the simulation.  
The 3D toolbar will move and align internally.  
Then click on the 3D toolbar, click on the 3D toolbar again, and then click on 3D movement.  
When you click on the 3D toolbar, the 3D model will change.  
The 3D model will move and align internally.  
Draw a 3D model.  
The CAD model will move.  
Cards can be selected by clicking on the T-shirt.

chunks.content: ## Aligning the Shoulder Line in CLO: Step-by-Step Procedure This section explains the detailed process of aligning the shoulder line in CLO using virtual measurement tools, 3D model adjustments, and simulation techniques. Key terms include "virtual model tape," "3D clothing line," "move tool," and "improve clothing quality tool." ### Opening and Preparing the Alignment File 1. Open the **ProduceFiles** folder and locate the **C.AligningShoulderSims** file inside the **FindTuning** folder. 2. Drag the **T-ShirtAligningShoulderSims** file into either the 3D or 2D window within CLO. 3. Press **5** on the keyboard to switch to the **top view** for easier alignment. ### Creating the Virtual Measurement Tape 1. In the 3D toolbar, select the **Surface Length Measurement Virtual Model Tool** from the virtual model tools. 2. Begin creating a virtual tape by clicking once along the shoulder line at the shoulder height. 3. Move the mouse cursor toward the shoulder line endpoint; an orange dot will follow the cursor. 4. Double-click at the endpoint to complete the virtual tape creation. ### Measuring and Aligning the 3D Clothing Line 1. Select the **3D Model Measurement Tool** from the 3D toolbar. 2. Click on the 3D clothing line; the bar will become transparent. 3. Click on the previously created virtual measurement tape. 4. Both lines will turn red, indicating they are selected. 5. The 3D clothing line will then move and align to the virtual measurement tape, ensuring accurate positioning. ### Adjusting the Clothing Fit and Quality 1. Switch to the **Move Tool** in the 3D toolbar. 2. If the T-shirt line is distant from the actual shoulder line, the clothing may shake sharply during simulation, causing undesirable wear effects. 3. Gently pull the clothing in simulation mode until it fits the virtual model accurately. 4. Select the **Improve Clothing Quality Tool** in the 3D toolbar. 5. Click **OK** to apply quality improvements. 6. Activate the simulation to observe the refined fitting. ### Editing and Finalizing the Virtual Measurement 1. Select the **Edit Measurement Virtual Model Tool** from the 3D toolbar. 2. Rotate the virtual model as needed for a clear view of the shoulder virtual measurement. 3. Click on the virtual measurement line and press the **Delete** key to remove it. 4. Activate simulation again to check the updated alignment. ### Additional 3D Model Movements and CAD Interaction 1. Use the 3D toolbar commands to move and align the 3D model internally by clicking multiple times on the 3D toolbar options and selecting **3D Movement**. 2. Drawing or moving the 3D model will cause the CAD model to adjust accordingly. 3. You can select specific cards or parts of the T-shirt by clicking on them directly in the 3D view. --- This workflow ensures precise shoulder line alignment, improving garment fit and realism in CLO simulations through careful measurement, adjustment, and simulation refinement.
